ideas.pitch: A real-time transit crowd and wheelchair accessibility forecasting tool built using historical GRT data and lightweight spatial models.
ideas.title: Waterloo Transit Occupancy & Accessibility Predictor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses local Waterloo infrastructure pain points that appeal directly to local judges and transit stakeholders.

ideas.pitch: An automated Ontario Standard Lease clause analyzer and historical rent increase calculator designed specifically for Waterloo student housing markets.
ideas.title: Co-op Housing Rent Shield & Lease Auditor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an urgent, highly relatable problem for the thousands of university students renting in Waterloo every term.

ideas.title: Campus Study Spot Micro-Marketplace
ideas.why_it_could_win: Taps into an everyday campus annoyance with a tight, highly demoable MVP scope.
